class.name: WorldLayer
class.brief_description: One layer of a world, as data.
class.description: A world's railways, roads, buildings, catenary, wires... of a section of a world ([WorldSection]), or of a sector of a world a plugin divides into sectors. The simulation's part of a world - tracks, traction, power sources, signals - is loaded whole with the world; a layer of a section holds what is only drawn (meshes, models, lines).

members.member: What its tracks are ([method TrackServer.track_get_group] of each).
Lines - the wires of power lines.
Geometry, its surfaces named after the game's material they are drawn with or carrying a material of their own.
Models of whichever model renderer's backend ([member ModelData.rendering_backend]).
The layer's name, the resource's own: what a tool keeps a layer by.
How far the meshes are drawn from [m]; 0: the draw distance.
